law_name: Law No. 171 of 21 December 2018 on the Protection of Natural Persons with regard to the Processing of Personal Data
scope: Natural persons with regard to processing of their personal data (including data held abroad)
key_requirements: GDPR-modelled law; security of processing (art. 33 cited in Garante sanction against Facebook); independent Garante supervises (art. 52) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: Data Protection Guarantor of San Marino (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali)
penalties_range: Administrative fines; Garante reportedly ordered Facebook to pay EUR 4M (challenged); statutory caps not found (unconfirmed)
notes: Garante has 3 members and 2 alternates (art. 52 as amended by Decree 84/2021); took office 2020-02-01; drafted to seek EU adequacy
